{{Top|leg}}
A '''ganther dance''' was a type of [[Music/Legends|music]]. [[Nabicci Futana]] composed ganther dances, many of which the [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] was scheduled to perform during its [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] tour beginning in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], members of the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' watched a ganther dance at a cultural center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].<ref name="dirp">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Death Is Remotely Possible|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
